newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: IBRD's first won bond lists on Seoul bourse.
newsitem.headline: IBRD's first won bond lists on Seoul bourse.

text.p: The first won denominated bond issued by the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) obtained a Seoul bourse listing on Wednesday, lead manager Daewoo Securities said.
The 95 billion won issue was launched on April 10 at home and abroad and carried a coupon of 9.8 percent.

An official at Daewoo Securities said payment for the five-year bonds was completed on Wednesday after 13 foreign and domestic financial institutions, including the lead manager, underwrote the issue.
Dealers said the IBRD bonds issue pushed yields on three-year benchmark corporate bonds higher in the local debt market.
